entities.name: Stonehaven
entities.description: A large, historically significant region in the west of the Dominarian continent of Corondor, once ruled by Ravidel.

entities.name: Adam Carthalion
entities.description: Lord of Ephren who died in the Battle of Aster Fall.

entities.name: Jared Carthalion
entities.description: Born in Ephren; fought Ravidel and destroyed Castle Melmereth.

entities.name: Castle Melmereth
entities.description: Seat of Adam Carthalion in Ephren, later Ravidel's residence, destroyed by Jared.

entities.name: Ephren

entities.name: Battle of Aster Fall
entities.description: Battle in which Adam Carthalion died and his army was destroyed.

entities.name: Krysalthus

events.summary: Adam Carthalion's army is destroyed at the Battle of Aster Fall and Ravidel takes up residence in Castle Melmereth.
events.quote: After Adam died in the Battle of Aster Fall , Ravidel took up residence in the castle.

events.summary: Jared Carthalion and Yorgo infiltrate Melmereth and Jared summons a Shivan Dragon, destroying it.
